name: Flights of Fancy
source:
This paranoid fever dream of a story explores the direct impact and consequences that a person's choice of fantasies and daydreams can have on real life.

[From [url=https://ilyilaice.itch.io/flights-of-fancy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个如同被妄想缠绕的高烧梦境般的故事，探讨了一个人选择沉溺于怎样的幻想与白日梦，会给现实生活带来怎样的直接影响与后果。

[摘自[url=https://ilyilaice.itch.io/flights-of-fancy]itch.io[/url]]
